photos.desc: Holotype specimen (IVPP V15471) of Epidexipteryx hui on display at the Paleozoological Museum of China.
Illustration of the maniraptoran ((dinosaur Epidexipteryx , here depicted with hands which is characteristic for members of the theropod family Scansoriopterygidae .
